description: Fetch live registry datasets, archived token/export data, or captured-run artifacts. Use it when you need complete machine-readable data; use catalog_list instead for component selection, object_registry for one object's definition, or registry_snapshot for mappings together with traits and objects. Returns data with provenance, version and cache metadata. dataset selects registry/export mode; version pins an archived export and listVersions lists dates. kind plus runPath selects captured artifacts, while derived_analysis reads an analysis directory via runPath; version/listVersions are refused in kind mode. includeInternal exposes hidden objects, and ifNoneMatch checks the canonical payload ETag. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#structured_data_fetch; full schema: oods://schemas/structured_data_fetch.input.json.

dataset.description: Local structured dataset to return (components/tokens/manifest). Mutually exclusive with kind+runPath.

ifNoneMatch.description: Return matched=true without payload when the ETag matches.

includeInternal.description: Live components dataset only: also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them; a dated export is served unchanged.

includePayload.description: When false, omit payload even if no ETag match occurs.

kind.description: Stage1 structured artifact kind to read from runPath. See full schema for details.

listVersions.description: When true, return available version dates instead of payload.

runPath.description: Filesystem path to a Stage1 run directory or its artifacts/ subdirectory. Required when kind is set.

version.description: Request a specific date-stamped version (e.g., '2026-02-24'). Omit for latest. Applies to dataset mode only.

name: structured_data_fetch
title: Fetch Structured Data
